texts.title_text: UK's alternative net-zero plan faces criticism over gas reliance and costs
texts.slide_1_text: UK’s Conservative plan proposes more gas power plants and less EV support, sparking debate.
texts.slide_2_text: Analysts warn the plan could cost £65-95bn in extra fuel expenses over two decades, due to reliance on gas.
texts.slide_3_text: The strategy assumes gas prices will drop and remain stable, despite recent spikes and global supply chain disruptions.
texts.slide_4_text: Experts argue the plan relies on unrealistic assumptions and may increase energy costs.
